messages:
raj: Quick follow-up postmortem thread for last night's LB anomaly — cross-region routing bounce + TLS handshake retry spike. Need owners, ETA, and whether this is a recurring pattern.

molly: Thanks. I collected the route-proxy logs and noticed repeated "apply rule timeout" when the controller retried. Pasting a snippet:```
2026-03-21T02:11:03Z route-proxy ERROR route_mod: apply rule timeout for cluster eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 (retry=3)
2026-03-21T02:11:04Z route-proxy WARN connection-manager: marking backend unhealthy after handshake timeout
```

alex: I can own the route-proxy backoff fix. Plan: change exponential backoff to capped linear for consecutive rule edits, add metric route_mod.backoff_count, and add unit+integration test. ETA EOD 2026-03-27 for prod roll.

raj: @alex thanks. Please also add a dashboard and an alert (SLO impact) so we spot recurrence earlier.

alex: will do — alert: route_mod.backoff_count > 0 for 5m during business hours -> P2. Dashboard tile + perf panel.

chloe: I'll take the LB handshake policy changes. Current behavior: LB retries TLS handshake aggressively (3x immediate retries) which amplified cross-region retries. Proposal: add randomized jitter between retries and backoff multiplier. Canary in us-west-2 then scale. ETA 2026-03-25.

molly: I traced a similar pattern in Nov 2025 (small) and Jan 2026 (medium). Looks like controller churn + immediate LB retries makes a recurrence cluster. We should add a regression test in staging that simulates route-controller flaps.

raj: Good call. @molly or @sven can you prototype a flappy-controller test harness?

sven: I can do a quick harness. Plan: simulate 30s of route edits at 5Hz against a staging cluster and assert handshake retry rate < 0.5% over 10m. Will post PR by 2026-03-24.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-2184 "LB: route-proxy backoff + TLS retry jitter" — link: https://issues.redwood/infract/INF-2184 (assigned to alex,chloe)

raj: Assigning owners summary: alex -> route-proxy backoff + metrics (due 03/27), chloe -> LB retry jitter + canary (due 03/25), sven -> regression harness + tests (due 03/24), molly -> postmortem notes + incident timeline (due 03/22).

molly: I've added the incident timeline to the postmortem doc (links in #eng-ops). Noting impact window: 2026-03-21T02:10–02:35Z, ~25m; SLO miss on inter-region p95 latency.

alex: Deployed backoff patch to staging at 2026-03-22T14:05Z. Staging metrics: route_mod.backoff_count -> 0 after patch. Will start prod rollout tomorrow morning with 10% canary.

chloe: Canary LB config applied to us-west-2 at 2026-03-23T09:10Z. Early telemetry: handshake retry rate down from 2.1% -> 0.12% over 3h window. :thumbsup:

sven: PR for test harness: https://git.redwood/platform/pulls/512 — includes simulated controller edits and assertions. Tagging @devex for CI stability.

raj: Good progress. Two open items we should track: 1) long-term fix to controller reconciliation that spikes edits (research ticket), 2) run monthly chaos/regression for routing+LB jitter. Owners?

molly: I'll own the research ticket for controller reconciliation and gather past incidents for correlation. Due 2026-04-10.

chloe: I'll schedule monthly routing+LB regression run and add to the oncall playbook.

alex: One request — can we lower the alert noise threshold for route_mod.backoff_count in non-prod? We saw a lot of false positives in staging earlier.

raj: Yes, use a staging-only threshold of >5 for 10m, prod stays >0 for 5m. Documented in INF-2184.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly check-in for INF-2184 scheduled: 2026-03-26T16:00Z. Invitees: alex,chloe,sven,molly,raj.

molly: Quick note on docs: added snippet for `curl -v --resolve` to reproduce TLS handshake timeouts for testing teams:```
curl -v --resolve api.redwood:443:52.8.12.34 https://api.redwood/healthz
* Connected to api.redwood (52.8.12.34) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* SSL connection using TLSv1.3 / TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
```

raj: Cool. Let's reconvene after the first canary metrics. I'll close this thread when INF-2184 is resolved and postmortem action items are complete. Thanks everyone. :v:
